title: Types of AI
description: Not all AI is the same! Let's explore the three big types of AI — and find out which one actually exists today.

content.value: Scientists describe AI in three levels based on how smart and flexible it is: Narrow AI, General AI, and Super AI.
1. Narrow AI (the AI we have today)
Narrow AI is really good at ONE specific job. A chess program can beat champions at chess — but it can't drive a car or cook dinner. Almost every AI you use today is Narrow AI.

Narrow AI examples:
♟️  Chess & game-playing programs
💬  ChatGPT and chatbots
🎯  Recommendation systems (YouTube, Spotify)
📧  Spam email filters

General AI would be as flexible as a human — able to learn and do ANY task across many different areas, from writing a poem to fixing a bike. This kind of AI does not exist yet. It's still a goal that researchers are working toward.

Super AI is a conceptual idea of a machine that is smarter than humans at almost everything. It only exists in movies and imagination for now — but thinking about it helps us plan how to build AI safely.
Activity — 'AI or Not?': Look at examples like a smart thermostat, a wind-up toy, a self-driving car, and a regular calculator. Which ones use AI, and which just follow fixed rules?
Key Takeaway: Most AI systems today are Narrow AI — brilliant at one task, but not flexible like a human.

quiz.question: Which type of AI do we actually use today?
quiz.explain: Everything from chatbots to recommendation systems is Narrow AI — great at one specific task. General and Super AI don't exist yet.

quiz.question: What makes General AI different from Narrow AI?
options: It could do almost any task, like a human, across many areas
quiz.explain: General AI would be flexible across many different tasks, just like a person — but it hasn't been built yet.

quiz.question: A program that ONLY recommends songs is an example of...
quiz.explain: It does one job — recommending songs — which makes it Narrow AI.
